info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Inventory Browser API

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of VMware vSphere servers to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of VMware vSphere servers to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts VMware vSphere servers by one of the VMware vSphere server parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts VMware vSphere servers in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters VMware vSphere servers by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any VMware vSphere server parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning and/or at the end.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/inventory/vmware/hosts` path allows you to get an array of all VMware vSphere servers added to the backup infrastructure.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the VMware vSphere server.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of objects to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts objects by one of the object parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts objects in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters objects by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any object parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

params.name: typeFilter
params.description: Filters objects by virtual infrastructure type.

params.name: parentContainerNameFilter
params.description: Filters objects by name of the parent container.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/inventory/vmware/hosts/{name}` path allows you to get an array of virtual infrastructure objects of the VMware vSphere server that has the specified `name`.
